run_GLEU_iterations: run GLEU scoring iterations on tokenized hypotheses against multiple reference sentences
load_references_GLEU: load tokenized reference sentences into the GLEU calculator for n-gram comparison
load_inputs_GLEU: load tokenized source input sentences into the GLEU calculator for n-gram extraction
compute_ngram_counts: compute n-gram counts of a given order for a tokenized sentence using GLEU
calculate_gleu_score: calculate the GLEU score from collected BLEU-relevant statistics with optional smoothing
